channel.title: Xabier Lameiro — Blog
channel.description: Practical, first-hand notes on React, Next.js and TypeScript: production errors, testing, CI/CD and web tooling.

item.title: How to measure a Next.js memory leak and prove the diagnosis
item.description: The measurement protocol behind a confirmed Next.js memory leak: forced GC with --expose-gc, heap snapshot diffs and retainer chains, and the before/after pair that proves the diagnosis. Automated in next-leak.

item.title: How to find a Next.js memory leak in production
item.description: The three Next.js memory leaks I measured and helped confirm, all fixed in 16.3.0: which one you have, how to prove it, and why serverless hides them as 504s.

item.title: Continuous Integration with Github Actions workflow
item.description: Set up CI/CD for a Next.js project with GitHub Actions: lint, test and build on every push, then deploy to Vercel. The workflow YAML explained step by step.

item.title: Filter for positions, survey to check compatibility
item.description: Survey for recruiters to find out if I am compatible with a specific job position

item.title: Dark mode in Next.js without the flash of the wrong theme
item.description: Dark mode in Next.js with CSS variables: resolve the theme before the first paint, persist the choice, and set color-scheme so scrollbars and form controls follow it.

item.title: Lighthouse report automation
item.description: Automation of Lighthouse reporting using playwright and the lightouse api on a deployed website in a real example

item.title: How to document React components with JSDoc
item.description: Generate documentation for your React components automatically with JSDoc and publish it as a static site — the setup, the annotations that matter, and how to deploy it.

item.title: How to translate URL slugs in a Next.js site
item.description: Translate your URLs per language for a fully internationalized Next.js site using static MDX pages — map localized slugs, keep canonicals clean, and link locales with hreflang.

item.title: Get a GitHub repo's star count without hitting rate limits
item.description: Read a GitHub repository's star count from stargazers_count, understand the 60 vs 5,000 requests-per-hour limits, and cache the call so a live counter costs one API request an hour.

item.title: Make a views counter with google analytics
item.description: Add a page-views counter to your Next.js blog using the Google Analytics Data API (BetaAnalyticsDataClient) behind an API route — auth, the report query and caching explained.

item.title: How to fix Minified React error #425 (hydration mismatch)
item.description: Fix Minified React error #425 ("Text content does not match server-rendered HTML"): every common cause of a hydration mismatch — dates, random values, locale formatting, browser-only APIs, invalid HTML — and the right fix for each, with Next.js examples.

item.title: Deploying my storybook is very simple
item.description: Deploy your Storybook as a static site so anyone can browse your React components online — the build command, where to host it, and how to wire it into CI. Step by step.

item.title: Fix "Failed to replace env in config: ${NPM_TOKEN}" in npm and yarn
item.description: How to fix the npm/yarn error "Failed to replace env in config: ${NPM_TOKEN}" in one minute: define the missing environment variable that your .npmrc expects, or remove the stale entry.

item.title: EADDRINUSE: address already in use — how to free the port
item.description: Fix "address already in use" in Node.js, Python, Docker, netcat and Playwright: find and kill the process holding the port on macOS, Linux and Windows, or run on another port.

item.title: How to publish the test coverage report in your React application
item.description: I show you how to publish the testing coverage report with jest in your React or Nextjs application, so you or people can see the testing coverage of your project.
